title: No musician had ever received India's highest civilian honor. Then one did.

sources.text: Gulf News, 2016 - M.S. Subbulakshmi birth centenary events launched (confirms September 16 birth date observance)

caption:
No musician had ever received India's highest civilian honor. Then one did.

Born September 16, 1916 in Madurai, Subbulakshmi built a seven-decade career in Carnatic and devotional music. In 1966, she became the first Indian to perform at the United Nations General Assembly.

In 1998, Subbulakshmi received the Bharat Ratna - India's highest civilian award - becoming the first musician in the country's history to hold it.

Her career ran across a period when India's own sense of what counted as a national achievement was still being defined. A classical singer reaching the country's highest civilian honor helped settle that question.
